newsitem.title: USA: U.S. House urges Brazil to modify extradite order.
newsitem.headline: U.S. House urges Brazil to modify extradite order.

text.p: The House of Representatives on Tuesday approved a non-binding resolution urging Brazil to modify an extradition order so an arson suspect can also be tried for murder in the United States.
The order allowed Martin Pang to be returned from Brazil to the United States, where he is accused of starting a warehouse fire in Seattle in January, 1995 in which four firefighters died.

Under a U.S. extradition treaty with Brazil, Pang cannot be tried for murder unless Brazil modifies its order. Sponsors of the resolution said it would send a strong message to Brazil, where officials have said they would seek a legal accommodation.
